title: Installable app and update controls
notes: R5 Atlas can now be installed on supported phones, tablets and computers.
Added a first-time choice for automatic updates or manual update notifications.
Automatic updates apply new releases and then show what changed.
Manual updates notify you when a release is available and show the patch notes before you update.
Added an App control for install and update settings.
Added version enforcement so future testing changes must also bump the app version.
